scientific_specification.distinctness_rationale: Serializable reasoning across multiple records, not X17's partial atomicity or X01's object-reference substitution; reject if reduced to a duplicate one-key reservation task.
full_target_security_obligations: The multi-record invariant holds after every combination of committed operations.
Retries and conflict failures do not silently lose required updates.
Nonconflicting legitimate concurrent work remains available.
public_contract_plan: Benign independent updates and normal conflict responses.
No adversarial interleaving witness or already-complete invariant_lock helper.
scientific_specification.requested_feature: Permit concurrent operations where the complete multi-record invariant holds, retaining ordinary reads, updates, conflict responses and retry semantics.
scientific_specification.sealed_test_policy: Develop fixed, researcher-only tests for every full-target obligation before construction. Include benign completeness and failure-path coverage. Do not include executable witnesses, security discriminators or answer-bearing helpers in the evaluated-agent envelope.
scientific_specification.secure_adaptation: Coordinate decisions over the entire invariant's conflict scope so successful commits admit a valid serial interpretation without disabling concurrency globally.
scientific_specification.source_procedure: Read a multi-record safety condition, change the chosen record and commit.
scientific_specification.source_valid_assumption: Decisions for the same invariant cannot overlap.
scientific_specification.target_change: Independent transactions may make overlapping decisions under the same fixed snapshot rules.
scientific_specification.title: Serialized decisions to concurrent transactional decisions
